title: Nazca Railway Development Plan 2024 Edition
safeHtml:
The Nazca Railway Development Plan 2024 Edition is a Development Plan proposed by Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division for Nazca Railway Development starting from 2024 in Season 4. It is divided into four parts, and was announced in phases on the Nazca Railway Discord Server starting from January 16 2024.

History[]

The Development Plan is split into Four Parts as follows:

Scope Release Date Location of Announcement Link
Part I January 16 2024 Nazca Railway Official Discord https://discord.com/channels/720326673853054978/720356555744346223/threads/1196682115195076628
Part II March 26 2024 https://discord.com/channels/720326673853054978/720356555744346223/threads/1222004764552724682
Part III May 31 2024 https://discord.com/channels/720326673853054978/720356555744346223/threads/1245977798842253352
Part I Supplementary Material April 6 2025 https://discord.com/channels/720326673853054978/720622290332811364/1358501668118991049

Full Text (Part I)[]

Nazca Railway is excited to share our upcoming development vision for Los Sengas in our 2024 edition. This plan highlights four key development areas, each with its distinct sectors.

The first part of our plan focuses on the northern area of Los Sengas. This includes Odyssey, Intus Aquilo, and the expansive Ingress Continent.

Odyssey[]

Odyssey, a fresh development area in Los Sengas, is located to the west of Rover and northwest of Sava. At present, Nazca Railway operates 3 stations in Odyssey. Our new development initiative will transform this network into a comprehensive system with 8 lines.

Our enhanced network in Odyssey will feature a variety of lines for comprehensive coverage. This includes Line 44, a circular, 3 east-west lines (Lines 8, 28, 29), a north-south line (Line 21), and 2 Veloduct lines (Golf, Lima). This diverse array of routes will ensure that residents and visitors in Odyssey can easily travel in any direction using Nazca Railway.

Intus Aquilo[]

Intus Aquilo has transformed from a once isolated island to a thriving development zone, extending to the coastlines across from the island. Recognizing this growth, Nazca Railway is eager to collaborate with local developers to enhance the area's transportation network. Our goal is to strengthen local connections and provide additional routes to and from Intus Aquilo.

With the expansion of our network, the coastline opposite Intus Aquilo will see significant enhancements. A new circular route, Line 40, will be introduced, and Line 3 will be extended northward. Additionally, Line 26 and the Mike Line will expand westward, with connections to the Lima Line.

On the east side, Line 27 will extend from Peacen Island up to the northeastern areas of Intus Aquilo, offering greater access and connectivity.

Ingress Continent[]

Ingress Continent is set to become a key area in Nazca Railway's development plans. At present, our network primarily serves the southern part of the continent, with Line 16 stretching all the way to the continent's north pole along its western border. This expansion marks a significant step in enhancing our railway coverage in the continent.

North-South Routes: Line 16 will continue as a vital route across the continent. Additionally, two new lines with the same direction are planned: Line 15 to the east and Line 6 through the central region. For faster travel, Line 16X and the Veloduct Charlie Line will provide express services.

East-West Routes: Nazca Railway will construct Line 29, Line 26, and Line 25, each supporting the Glacier, Asylum, and Snowty regions respectively. The Veloduct Mike Line will also offer express services, particularly complementing Line 26.

Gateway: The Ingress Continent houses one of Los Sengas's eight major gateways, named “Winter Point”. This station is set to connect Line 15, 26, 29, and the Mike Line, making it a key hub in our network.

Full Text (Part II)[]

Nazca Railway is excited to share our upcoming development vision for Los Sengas in our 2024 edition. This plan highlights four key development areas, each with its distinct sectors.

The second part of our plan is about the eastern region of Los Sengas, involving Egress, Yowah, Torrent, Clouds, Cometsilk and Prymea.

Northern Yowah, Egress & Torrent[]

The northern part of Yowah region lacks the service of Nazca Railway and this will change very soon with a plan consists of 5 lines.

During PreSeason 4 Phase 2, Line 7 (Luxter Line) has extended to Mangkhut Sound. In this plan, Line 7 will extend further to the east to Abunest in Torrent and turn north to Daisy Island. In addition, Line 7C will establish, it will connect Twintip Rivers Station and Prosand Station and the area in between.

Line 13 (Origin Line) and Veloduct Fox Line will go straight east from Sand Martin Checkpoint, setting up stations along the islands and turn north around Hammer Bay to Daisy Island.

The section between Zootuary Station and Sand Martin Checkpoint of the Alpha Line will switch service to a new Veloduct Line, Juliet Line, and extend to the east to Yowah North and Abunest.

Last but not least, Kilo Line will extend northward from Pi Lake Station to Daisy Island via Abunest as well. When all 4 lines mentioned have service at Daisy Island, this station will upgrade as a Checkpoint.

Cometsilk & Prymea[]

The major development zone of the southeastern area are the southern region of Prymea. The main network expansion is around Line 17 (Oasis Bay Line). Line 17 will extend southeast from Southern Heights Station and go all the way to the east to Borealis continent (a large piece of snow biome).

Moreover, Line 31 (Daybreaker Line), Line 45 (Starshore Line) and Veloduct Kilo Line will also extend to the south(east) and meet Oasis Bay Line at Spring Point Gateway. Where Line 45 is a new line starts from Nail Bight Checkpoint.

Line 28 (Phoenix Line) will also extend southeast and interchange with Line 17 at the border of Borealis continent.

The Amber Line[]

There will be a new north-south line further east of Blackstone Village. Stay tuned for further updates!

Full Text (Part III)[]

Nazca Railway is excited to share our upcoming development vision for Los Sengas in our 2024 edition. This plan highlights four key development areas, each with its distinct sectors.

The third part of our plan is about the southwest region of Los Sengas, involving Jupiter, Teraleros an western Xofa.

Jupiter & 22nd[]

The majority of Jupiter continental has been developed during Season 3 development. In this plan, Nazca Railway’s development plan in Jupiter will involve the islands in the Archipelago at Strait of Freedom.

To begin with, Line 17 (Oasis Bay Line) and Echo Line will continue westbound to Joyhill Island and Sandshore Island. Line 17 will “land” on south side of 22nd continent and spurs around the southern part of the continent, as Line 17A (Greensleeves Line). The main line will go to the west while the spur will connect to Summer Point Gateway.

At the mean time, Line 9 (Kinight Line) will proceed southbound from Darey Terrace to interchange with Line 17 in both islands. After that, Line 9 will continue south towards Markost.

Echo Line will have a stop at Joyhill Island, interchangeable with Line 9 and Line 17, then it will go to Summer Point Gateway as well with a slightly northern path of Line 17.

In addition, Line 32 (Vision Line), will follow the coastline of 22nd continent until it turns westbound. This line will end at Summer Point Gateway.

Teraleros[]

Teraleros (and future Poloros to the south) is a major development zone for Nazca Railway long term network expansion.

In the Teraleros, the northern part of the continent, will extend a number of existing lines including (but not limited to) Line 4 (New Edward Line), Line 9 (Kinight Line), Line 17 (Oasis Bay Line), Line 35 (Wanderer Line). Also there will be new lines such as Line 17A (Greensleeves Line), a new loop Line 33 (Tachyon Line) and more.

Also Nazca Railway will establish a new Terminal-class station called “Cityyard Shrine” which will be just south of Ontario Sound Station.

Western Xofa[]

The expanse of western Xofa is going to be included as well, to motivate the development of the region and its vicinity.

Line 11 (Zephyr Line) and Line 12 (Sparkling Line) will have further extension to the west side of the Peckern Continent. Line 11 will continue in northwest direction mainly and connect with Apple Hill Station while setting up interchange stations with Line 12 and Fox Line. Line 12 will mainly go westward.

Furthermore, Nazca Railway will establish a new Veloduct, the Hotel Line. Starts at Centopia, heading west to Orama Island, central Xofa and to Apple Hill. This line is expected to have transfer with Line 11, Line 12 and Fox Line.

Fun Facts[]

  • While Part I of the original text states that Nazca Railway operates three stations in Odyssey at the time of its completion, there were only two stations in the region as Gunshot Island Station is located within Rover instead of Odyssey. The only two stations in Odyssey at the time were Dragonire Bay Station and Helios Station.
  • None of the Standard Railway Lines are explicitly named in Part I of the original text. However, by increasing order of line number, the Standard Railway Lines involved, as well as their respective districts, are as follows:
    • Line 3: Urban Line (Intus Aquilo)
    • Line 6: Arcgo Line (Ingress Continent)
    • Line 8: Flask Line (Odyssey)
    • Line 15: Ingress Line (Ingress Continent)
    • Line 16X: Glacier Express (Ingress Continent)
    • Line 21: Stadow Line (Odyssey)
    • Line 25: Asylum Line (Ingress Continent)
    • Line 26: Snowty Line (Intus Aquilo, Ingress Continent)
    • Line 27: Pegasus Line (Intus Aquilo)
    • Line 28: Phoenix Line (Odyssey)
    • Line 29: Rover Line (Odyssey, Ingress Continent)
    • Line 40: Aquilo Circuit (Intus Aquilo)
    • Line 44: Odyssey Circular (Odyssey)
  • Line 34 (Coopol Line) is not explicitly mentioned in the original text. However, it is shown in the picture version of Part I of the development Plan.
  • The Picture Version of the Ingress Continent Plans was not released until one year and four months after the release of Part I of the Plans on April 6 2025 in the Discord Server, and the picture version of the plans also included Lingshan Line, which was not mentioned in the Text. However, Charlie Line and Mike Line were not seen in the picture version.
  • While the name of Line 7C was not explicitly mentioned in Part II of the original text, it has already been confirmed that the line will be named Wingthorn Line.

Differences between Plans and Actual Developments[]

As the Plans are only considered a tentative and general overview of potential developments, finalized developments may be different from the initial version written in the Plans. Following list includes the items that were eventually amended after the release of their respective plans.

Odyssey (Part I, S4E2-S4E4)[]

  • Odyssey Circular was initially not planned to interchange with Rover Line, which was later added (Keystone) to facilitate connections along the north-eastern Odyssey region.
  • Flask Line was initially planned to enter Odyssey at the area around Hotwellsham, which was eventually moved to the north (Sirius) to provide service along Egret Docks as well as to include Lima Line at Sirius Station which was not planned at first.
  • Location of Fishpond Vale is moved northward significantly due to limitations for Golf Line to switch from overground to underground section after Horsepower Island.

Intus Aquilo, Valor (Part I, S4E5, S4E9)[]

  • Aquilo Circuit and Pegasus Line were planned to not have interchange station(s) initially, which was later added through adding Clovefront; Such addition also caused the station number of Aquilo Circuit at Branches' Hallow to be moved from 40-03 to 40-04.
  • The Plans did not showcase the Development of Urban Line and Lingshan Line within Valor. However, its development took place concurrently with north Intus Aquilo in S4E9.

Ingress Continent（Part I, S4E6-S4E8）[]

  • There are several differences regarding the Text Version of the Development Plan and the Supplementary Diagram of the Ingress Continent Plans, which includes the following:
    • The lack of detailed plans for Coopol Line and Lingshan Line, with the former only appearing on one of the images attached to the Picture Version, and the latter not appearing altogether.
    • Asylum Line and Charlie Line was not yet confirmed to pass through Winter Point Gateway at the text version.
    • Despite Charlie Line and Mike Line not being included in the Diagram of the Ingress Continent, their routes are planned in accordance to the Text Version of the Development Plans.

Cometsilk & Prymea (Part II, S4E10-S4E11)[]

  • Starshore Line was initially planned to interchange with Cometsilk Line at Milky Realm and traverse directly southwards to Spring Point before turning southeast. However, the southeast turn is moved northwards, and Starshore Line now interchanges with Cometsilk Line at Welliant Plateau instead. 2 Additional Stations are also added compared to the initial plan due to Prymea Development. (Rougewood and Angelica Moss).
  • There are several changes regarding the final Daybreaker Line Route compared to the Diagram Version of the Plans:
    • After Blue Swamp, Daybreaker Line travels further east to interchange with Punctual Line at New Glade instead of turning directly southwards.
    • The second East Ring Line interchange is now located at Visitor's Ground instead of Backcomma Beach as initially planned due to the aforementioned changes.
    • Daybreaker Line turns east at a further south location compared to the diagram, and begins to run in parallel with Oasis Bay Line at Mount Qin West instead of simply interchanging at Spring Point, where this line permanently terminates.
  • There are several changes regarding the final Oasis Bay Line Route compared to the Diagram Version of the Plans:
    • After Southern Heights, Oasis Bay Line travels further south before turning east, and deviates slightly north after Pinewatch to run in parallel with Daybreaker Line between Mount Qin West and Spring Point.
    • The Phoenix Line interchange is now located to the northeast of the Diagram's location.
  • Phoenix Line was initially planned to interchange with Oasis Bay Line at the junction between Route 15 and the highway to Clouds. However, it now makes a southeast turn at the sea after Minnewinchispa, and Phoenix Line now interchanges with Oasis Bay Line at Cyban instead.

Current Progress[]

  • January 16 2024: Part I of the Plans was released.
  • March 26 2024: Part II of the Plans was released.
  • May 31 2024: Part III of the Plans was released.
  • April 6 2025: The Plans for Ingress Continent was released, which is the considered the supplementary information for Part I of the development plan.

The following development are mentioned in the Development Outline, and have already been completed in the order of Development Chapters and Chronological Order:

  • S4E9:
    • Aquilo Circuit Phase 2 (Branches' Hallow to Softgrade Valley)

  • S4E6:
    • Coopol Line Phase 1 (Flask East to Saber Tower)
    • Ingress Line Phase 2 (Chilly Canyon to Winter Point)

  • S4E7:

Part II[]

  • S4E10:
    • Kilo Line Phase 2 (Nail Bight to Spring Point)

Other Contemporary Development[]

The following Development are not mentioned in the Development Outline, but are nonetheless developed at around the same time as the developments mentioned in the outline. These developments showcases development that takes place in the time period between the release of this Outline and the time when everything mentioned in this outline is completed, and it should also be noted that, while such development are not included in the Development Outline, they usually serve as a precursor or an extension to related development within this Outline:

Mayler Airport[]

  • S4E1 (Served as a Precursor to Lima Line Development in this Outline):
    • Lima Line Phase 1 (Old Brightland to Sava Canyon)

    • Skyward Line Phase 2 (Mayler Airport 1 to Mayler Airport 2)

title: Nazca Railway Platform Screen Doors
safeHtml:
Nazca Railway is the first Minecraft Railway System in the world to widely adopt Platform Screen Doors for all its stations during construction and operation.

Contents

  • 1 Technical Information
  • 2 Usage
  • 3 Platform Screen Door Type Description
    • 3.1 Classic PSDs
    • 3.2 Basic PSDs
    • 3.3 Liquid PSDs
    • 3.4 Aerial PSDs
    • 3.5 Open PSDs
    • 3.6 Medjay Platform Gates
  • 4 Citations and References

Technical Information[]

Nazca Railway Platform Screen Doors (PSDs) are based on the Vanilla Redstone System that came with Minecraft. The "Hardware" of the PSD mainly consists of glass, and redstone lamps are used as indicators for door status (Open/Close). Pistons, command blocks and redstone wiring are also designed in the fashion of a switch. Newer models of PSDs make use of "Platform announcements" and Flashing Lights to increase the convenience of passengers using Nazca Railway.

Usage[]

  • Prevent Water Influx into tarcks.
  • Prevent malicious/accidental breaches into the track area.
  • Prevent malicious attacks from other passengers when trains are arriving.

Platform Screen Door Type Description[]

Classic PSDs[]

  • Applicable For: Platforms with High Ceiling Height
  • Variations: Classic PSD, Reverse Classic PSD, Classic+ PSD

Classic PSDs are designed for platforms and stations with high ceiling height. The Door indicators are located above the platforms, but this model does not support Platform Gates.

  • Applications: Most PSDs at Urban Stations (Metropolis Terminal, Intus Aquilo Gateway etc.)
Classic PSDs
Reverse Classic PSDs

Basic PSDs[]

  • Applicable For: Platforms with Low Ceiling Height
  • Variations: Basic Platform Gates, Basic PSDs, Reverse Basic PSDs, Heightened Basic Platform Gates

Basic PSDs are designed for platforms with low ceiling height. The door indicators are placed on the floor. This model supports Platform Gates.

  • Applcations: Most Ground, Pseudoground Station Platform Gates, Island Station PSDs (Metro Stone Station, Origin Station etc.)
    • I-River Station is the first station to use Heightened Basic Platform Gates.
    • Currently, Nazca Railway no longer builds new Basic Platform gates that are only 1 block high. All new Basic Platform Gates are of the Heightened Basic Platform Gate variation.
    • Originally, Katadelphia Station uses Basic Platform Gates that are 1 block high, but since the construction of Katadelphia City Center Node, the platform gates have been converted to the Heightened Basic Platform Gates that are two blocks high.
Basic Platform Gates
Basic PSDs
Heightened Basic PSDs

Liquid PSDs[]

  • Applicable For: Special platforms with High Ceiling Height
  • Variations: Liquid PSDs

The first prototypes of this type of platform gates are seen at Mangrove Pass Station of Terracept Division. Liquid PSDs are improved version of Classic PSDs. While they are also used for Stations with High Ceiling Height, the required platform width of using this design is reduced to zero. However, this design does not support Platform Gates.

  • Applications: Overground stations with Special Platforms (eg. Transparent Platforms, Platforms with Water/Lava Underneath etc.) (Congorge Station, Treeless Hill Station, Glacier Station etc.)
Liquid PSDs

Aerial PSDs[]

  • Applicable For: Low Ceiling Height
  • Variations: Aerial Platform Gates, Aerial PSDs, Reverse Aerial PSDs

Aerial PSDs can be seen as a combination of Basic Platform Gates and Liquid PSDs. It is designed to reduce the required width of Platform Gates. However, PSD variations for Aerial Platform Gates are also available.

  • Applications: Overground Stations or Island Stations with special Platforms (Miner North Station, TriPaw Station. Eagle Island Station etc.)
Aerial Platform Gates
Aerial PSDs
Reverse Aerial PSDs

Open PSDs[]

  • Applicable For: Low Ceiling Height
  • Variations: Open PSDs

Open PSDs look identical to Basic PSDs, except that no electronic circuit boards are required above the platforms. However, this design does not support Platform Gates

  • Applications: East Margin Station[1]
The only known set of existing Open PSDs to date

Medjay Platform Gates[]

  • Used exclusively by Local Rapid Transits, Medjay Platform Gates are the simplified version of other platform gates. However, this set of platform gates does not support flashing lights.
  • Applications: All Local Rapid Transit stations.
Medjay Platform Gates

Citations and References[]

  1. ↑ In order to avoid affecting nearby terrain, this station is built at a high height of 115m and uses Plateau Station designs. Therefore, the Open PSD is designed specifically for that station.

title: Nazca Railway Station Numbering and Directional System
displayTitle: Nazca Railway Station Numbering and Directional System
aliases: Nazca Railway Station Numbering and Directional System
safeHtml:
The Nazca Railway Station Numbering and Directional System is a numbering system used by all current stations of the NR Los Sengas Division after the construction of Steep Pond Station.

Contents

  • 1 Description
    • 1.1 The Shuttle
    • 1.2 Local Rapid Transit
  • 2 Examples
  • 3 List of "Zero Stations"
  • 4 Citations and References

Description[]

The Station Numbering of this system can be divided into two parts, namely Route Number and Station Number. For "Post-Zero Stations" ("Pre-Zero Station" start from the number "00", and increases with the increase in mD sign), the numbering order starts with Route Number, and followed by Station Number (eg. XX-YY). However, for "Pre-Zero Stations" ("Pre-Zero Stations" start from the number "01", and increass with the decrease in mD sign), the numbering order starts with Station Number, and followed by Route Number (eg. YY-XX).

For routes featuring express services (eg. Urban Line), stations that support the Express Service would have a letter "X" appeneded to the route number for classification purposes. For instance, despite being an Urban Line station, High Mesa Station does not have Urban Express services. As a result, the station code for Urban Line of that station is 3-01. However, since Intus Austrum Gateway of the same line features Urban Express, the station code of that station is 07-3X.

Morever, station codes are subject to changes announced by Nazca Railway, and Route Numbers have brackets inserted for clarification. If new stations were inserted between existing stations, all stations that are after the inserted station in the respective direction would have their station numbers adjusted.

It should also be noted that "Post-Zero Stations" and "Pre-Zero Stations" are formerly named "Up-direction Stations" and "Down-direction Stations". However, they are renamed to their current names after the completion of Centopia Development.

The Shuttle[]

Station numbering for The Shuttle operates differently. The numbering of nodes are divided in 4 quadrant directions (Namely NW (North-west), SW (South-west), NE (North-east) and SE (South-east), as well as the order of construction of that node in chronological order. However, for Metropolis Terminal, the Station Number for The Shuttle is marked by the letter "O", signifying the Origin of The Shuttle.

Right: Quadrant
Down: Chronological Order 		NW (North-West) SW (South-West) NE (North-East) NE (South-East)
01 Sava Central Numpool Katadelphia City Center Media City
02 Midway Island Prosand Old Brightland
03 Wui King

As seen from the above table, since Sava Node is the first node to be constructed to the northwesterly direction of the Origin (Metropolis), the station number of that node is NW-01.

Local Rapid Transit[]

Local Rapid Transits (LRTs) would not assign a route number for each individual route. Instead, the station numbers in the same LRT system are assigned with the same set of numbers, increasing in chronological order of construction or by development order of the route. Usually, numbers increase from the Downward Terminus of the routes involved.

It should also be noticed that there are no "Zero-Stations" (ie. (XX)-00) for LRTs and the first station would be marked (XX)-01.

Examples[]

Metropolis Terminal: 1-00, 2-00, 3X-00, 4-00, 5-00, 6-00, 13-00, 27-00, 28-00, A-02, B-00, C-00, D-00, F-00, L-00, O

  • Except for Alpha Line, all Standard Railway, Veloduct and Hub Railway lines use this station as the "Zero Station". As a result, the station number is X-00.
  • As Metropolis Terminal is defined to be the Origin of The Shuttle, the station code is O for The Shuttle.

Flask East Checkpoint: 06-5, 8-22, 28-07, 34-00, 01-B

  • This station is situated at the sixth station and the first station at the downward direction starting from the "Zero Station" (Metropolis Terminal) for Stadium Line and Bravo Line respectively. As a result, the station numbers for Stadium Line and Bravo Line are 06-5 and 01-B respectively.
  • This station is the 22nd station at the upward direction starting from the "Zero Station" of Flask Line (Which is currently unknown). As a result, the Station Number for Flask Line is 8-22.
    • It should however be noted that station numbers may be reserved for future development and hence may not have a station that is assigned to that number yet.
  • This station is the seventh station at the upward direction starting from the "Zero Station" (Metropolis Terminal) for Phoenix Line. As a result, the Station Number is 28-07.
  • Coopol Line uses this station as the "Zero Station". As a result, the station number for Coopol Line is 34-00.

Bufly Island Station: 1-09, 7-00, 03-21

  • This station is the ninth station at the upward direction starting from the "Zero Station" (Metropolis Terminal) for West Ring Line. As a result, the Station Number is 1-09.
  • This station is the "Zero Station" of Luxter Line. As a result, the Station Number is 7-00.
  • This station is the third station at the downward direction starting from the "Zero Station" (Abutment Island Station) for Stadow Line. As a result, the Station Number is 03-21.

Rover Down Checkpoint: 3X-03, 7-06, G-00

  • This station is the third station at the upward direction starting from the "Zero Station" (Metropolis Terminal) for Urban Line. As a result, the Station Number is 3-03.
  • However, as Urban Express also stops at this station, to differentiate between stations with Urban Express and stations without it, the current Station Number is 3X-03.
  • This station is the sixth station at the upward direction starting from the "Zero Station" (Bufly Island Station) for Luxter Line. As a result, the Station Number is 7-06.
  • This station is the "Zero Station" for Golf Line. As a result, the Station Number is G-00.

Sava Node: NW-01

  • This node is the first one to be built at the Northwesterly direction of Metropolis Terminal for The Shuttle. As a result, the Station Number is NW-01.

Prosand Station: 10-5, 03-B, NE-02

  • This station is the tenth station at the downward direction starting from the "Zero Station" (Metropolis Terminal) for Stadium Line. As a result, the Station Number is 10-5.
  • Despite Bravo Line no longer stopping at this station, as this station features Emergency Platforms for Bravo Line, this station is still counted into the station numbering order of Bravo Line. As this station is the third station at the downward direction starting from the "Zero Station" (Metropolis Terminal), the Station Number is 03-B.
  • For The Shuttle, as this station is the second node to be constructed at the Northeasterly direction of Metropolis Terminal, the Station Number is NE-02.

Boundary Island Station: 4-A04

  • This station belongs to the first downward station on a Branch Line that starts from Compass Island Station. Since the Station Number for Compass Island Station is 4-04, the station number for this station is 4-A04, with "A" indicating the first branch line station. The fact that "A" is put before the actual number (04) means that this station is a downward branch line station.

Lei Wik Estate Stop: ST-01

  • As this stop is the first one to be planned and built for Shore Tip LRT, the station number for this stop is ST-01.

New Edward Line is Line Number 4 of NR Los Sengas Division. It mainly serves the south of Downtown, and has 29 stations alnog the line. This line commenced services on April 21 2015 and runs between Hillfield and Le Monde. Moreover, a branch between Compass Island and Boundary Island is set up on this branch, which commenced services on June 25 2016.

Description[]

New Edward Line is a core line in NR Los Sengas Division. Most of the list lies at the south of Downtown, and passes through Twenty-Second Continent, West Metropolis Archipelago, Downtown, Katadelphia, Flask, Punctual and Cometsilk.

This route is represented by Lime Color on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 4.

Currently, this route is 51.06 km long, with a total of 29 stations.

History[]

Development Chapters[]

  • S1E3: Metropolis - Seat River
  • S1E6: Kaling Sea - Seat River
  • S1E16: Kaling Sea - Comp Ward

  • S3E14P2: Nail Bight, Boundary Island - Le Monde
  • S3E15: Hillfield, Boundary Island - Le Monde

Nazca Railway 2021 Development Outline[]

Direction Development Details Progress
Up Extend from Python Delta Station to Le Monde Checkpoint to interchange with Daring Line. Completed

Extend towards Teraleros at the southwest direction from Le Monde Checkpoint. TBC
Down Extend to the Southeast of Nail Bight Checkpoint and interchange with Cometsilk Line once again.[2] Completed
(Chapter: S3E15)

Districts Served[]

  • Cometsilk

Line Charcteristics[]

  • One of the initially planned lines of NR Los Sengas Division.
  • This line is named after a series of players that are all named "Edward" in Project Nazca. However, since Nazca Railway already had a line named Edward Line in Terracept Division, and this division was new at the time of this line's planning, the word "New" is added before the line name.
  • Mainly serves the south of Downtown.
  • The section between Seat River and Compass Island shares tracks with Alpha Line and Bravo Line, and hence this line became Nazca Railway's first line to share a tunnel with two other lines. The section that shares tracks has the same speed limit as Veloducts.
  • The section in Katadelphia makes use of a glass sound barrier that completely surrounds the tracks.
  • After the completion of Boundary Island Station, this line became the first line to have three termini in Los Sengas Division (Le Monde, Boundary Island, Hillfield).
  • This Line has a crossover track between Litchi Lake and Kelper Mount of East Ring Line for Through Train services. Passengers could board the trains along the to Hillfieldand change to stations along the Outer Ring direction, or board East Ring Line trains along the Inner Ring direction at Kelper Mount and change tracks to the Direction of this line.
  • This line passes through the most stations with a station park, namely Python Delta, Metropolis, Aest, Flask South and Nail Bight.
  • Express Services of this line:
    • Alpha Line: Metropolis to Comp Ward
    • Bravo Line(West): Metropolis to Le Monde(Through Edward Island)
    • Delta Line(East): Metropolis to Nail Bight

Fun Facts[]

  • Brain Island Station started services on October 27 2015. As Nazca, the builder of Nazca Railway, has his birthday on the same day, that station became the commemorative station for his birthday.
  • This line is home to the most stations with multipole color schemes, namely Python Delta, Java Beach, Aest, Newmonth River and Hillfield.
  • At the time of S3E14-2, both ends of New Edward Line used to be checkpoints (Le Monde and Nail Bight are both checkpoints). However, by S3E15, this characteristic was no longer present as New Edward Line has since extended to Hillfield.

New Judy Island Monorail is the Light Rail System on New Judy Island. It is ran by Peckern Transit.

Station List[]

Currently, New Judy Island Monorail has six stations as follows:

  • Westlava Station
  • New Judy Port Station
  • Great Nazca Aquarium Station (Interchange with Nazca Railway Stadium Line)
  • East New Judy Station (Interchange with Nazca Railway Stadium Line)
  • New Judy 1st. Station
  • Tui Shek Kok Station

After Tui Shek Kok Station, New Judy Island Monorail will go back to Westlava Station.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the last of a series of three stations that are built to commemorate a friend of the Railway Builder, with the other two stations being Johnson Views Station and Kelper Mount Station.
  • The black and white color scheme of this station alludes to the New Moon.
  • The north side, which uses White Wool, has a slight opening at platforms for passengers to see the outside view, whereas the south side, which uses Black Wool, is completely sealed off.
  • The Stairs at the West and East Ends of this station, enables transfer between trains of the opposite direction.
  • Sound Barriers are inserted at the East Ring Line tracks in order to prevent noise pollution.

History[]

  • June 24 2017: This station completed construction.[2]
  • June 25 2017: This station began services alongside East Ring Line, but New Edward Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • July 1 2017: New Edward Line extended from Justin Station to Hourglass Bay Station through Litchi Lake Station and this station.
  • July 24 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[3]

title: Ngo Tseung Railway (Mosaic Island)
safeHtml:
Ngo Tsueng Railway (Mosaic Island) runs the Light Rail System on Mosaic Island.

Contents

  • 1 Station List
  • 2 Characteristics
  • 3 Gallery
  • 4 Citations and References

Station List[]

Currently, Ngo Tseung Railway has one line in Mosaic Island with four stations as follows:

  • South-North Line:
    • Mosaic Island NR Station Station (Interchange with Nazca Railway Gondola Line, Peckern Transit Northland Line)
    • Mosaic Island Park Station (Interchange with Nazca Railway Stadow Line)
    • Mosaic Island Pier Station
    • Seaside Road Station

After Seaside Road Station, South-North Line will go back to Mosaic Island NR Station Station.

Characteristics[]

  • This railway system is the first light railway system in West Metropolis Archipelago and the third railway in general to use SignPicture signs in Los Sengas.
  • Despite being a light railway, the stations are designed in the style of heavy railways.
  • Mosaic Island Pier Station is the first light railway station in Los Sengas to share structure with a pier. It is also the first station in Ngo Tseung Railway to NOT feature entry gates, as well as featuring the longest light railway platforms in Mosaic Island at 59m.

title: Nick-train
safeHtml:
The Nick Train is an inspection train used by Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.

Contents

  • 1 Technical Information
    • 1.1 Exterior and Outlook
    • 1.2 Variants
  • 2 Application

Technical Information[]

Exterior and Outlook[]

  • Driver Cab Car Length: 25000 mm
  • Normal Car Length: 22000 mm
  • Width: 3000 mm
  • Height: 3750 mm

Variants[]

The first train: NS001 - NS002 - NS004 - NS003
The second train: NS011 - NS012 - NS014 - NS013
The third train: NS021 - NS022 - NS024 - NS023
The fourth train: NS031 - NS032 - NS034 - NS033
Spare Carriages: NS044, NS054

NS0x1 (The first carriage): Features supersonic wave emisssion systems that detects defects on the track. This carraige also features signal testing facilities to test whether train signals are operating normally.

NS0x2 (The second carriage): Features electric inspection facilities that checks whether electric supply is operating normally and whether there is sufficient space for rolling stocks to pass through a certain section.

NS0x4 (The third carriage): This carriage is a VIP carriage that is used when senior members of Nazca Railway are performing inspections. This carriage is complete with a conference room and a pantry, and does not have to be used when performing daily inspections.

NS0x3 (The fourth carriage): Features supersonic wave emisssion systems that detects defects on the track. This carraige also features signal testing facilities to test whether train signals are operating normally.

Application[]

Each depot features a Nick-Train to run on lines that is managed by the depot. Since this train is registered, tracks do not have to be closed when this train in operation so that other trains can run normally on existing tracks.

However, on routes that are not connected to other existing lines, this train can only use mini-robots that are not registered, and the entirety of the track section has to be closed. For instance, Sparkling Line and Everchord Line make use of this inspection method.

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is Nocturne Filament.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Where Cold Order Moves and Night Becomes String".

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the first station to be built in 2026.
  • This station, alongside West Hill Station and Winter Point Gateway, are all interchange stations of Asylum Line and Snowty Line. This is the third set[2] of "Triplet Interchanges" in Nazca Railway, with the first two sets being Hartasy Line, Wardring Line and West Ring Line, Luxter Line respectively[3]. However, unlike the previous sets, which adopted the standard rule of having one station for same direction, opposite direction, and inter-floor interchanges, this set of triplet interchanges had two stations that are of opposite directions[4] and one station with the same direction being West Hill Station.

History[]

  • January 4 2026: This Station began construction.
  • January 6 2026: This Station completed construction.
  • January 7 2026: This station began services alongside Snowty Line, but Asylum Line Platforms remain reserved.

Fun Facts[]

Fun Facts[]

  • The Railway Builder often mispronouced the name of this station as North Coast Road Stop as most Local Rapid Transit stops end with the word "Road".[3]
  • This Station is the first Pseudoground Station on Arcgo Line, and the design of this station also takes reference from War-Arc Station with regards that the two platforms are NOT located within the same struture.[4]
  • The separate structures in each platform is due to the fact that, as Peckern City Circular tracks arrived at the location of this station before Arcgo Line, the platform structures have to be separated.[5]
  • The North Concourse and South Concourse of this station is separated by a three-lane dual carriageway.

History[]

  • August 4 2021: This station began services.

As a result, no trace of this isle's existence is found.

Fourth Anniversary Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 0
  • Just walk to the Sava Line Wing of the Concourse and get your souvenir.
  • The Fourth Anniversary Souvenir comes in the form of a Diamond Shovel and The Paper of North Mountain.

Fun Facts[]

  • After the Sava Line expansion of this station, this station became the third station in Los Sengas Division to feature NR Shops.
  • The Paper of North Mountain is a special souvenir that could only be obtained from this station.
  • The Sava Line platforms of this station do not feature any Platform Screen Doors.
  • This station has the most NR Shops in any Los Sengas Division station with 60 shops.
  • The Sava Line Wing of the Concourse alludes to the Tuen Ma Line section of Tai Wai Station of the MTR in Hong Kong, in particular the slanted passageway between Platforms 3 and 5, as well as the vertical direction signs for Luxter Line and Sava Line.[3]
  • The completion of standardization of Sava Line platforms in this station marks the completion of the standardization of the whole Sava Line, which is completed on February 19 2024.

History[]

  • August 5 2015: This station began services alongside Luxter Line.
  • June 17 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[4]
  • July 5 2016: This station completed expansion of the Sava Line section.
  • July 8 2016: Sava Line is established.
  • October 19 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[5]
  • January 6 2021: The Luxter Line section of this station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[6]
  • March 1 2023: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[7]
  • March 4 2023: The Station Title Banner of this station is added.
  • February 19 2024: The Sava Line Platforms have their Platform Gates installed.
  • August 16 2024: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[8]

title: North Numpool Bridge
safeHtml:
North Numpool Bridge is a bridge that is used by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division).

Description[]

  • Bridge Type: Cable-stayed bridge
  • Length: 486 m
  • Number of Decks: Double-Deck
    • Upper Deck: Charlie Line Tracks
    • Lower Deck: West Ring Line Tracks
  • Lines Served: West Ring Line, Charlie Line
  • Location: Numpool Station - South Bay Station

Technical Information and Characteristics[]

  • The first Cable-stayed bridge in Los Sengas
  • This bridge was originally a single-deck cable-stayed bridge, but later became a Double-Deck Cable-stayed Bridge due to reserved routes for Charlie Line.
  • This bridge connectes the South Bay Terminal and Numpool Terminal of the Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals.

Citations and References []

History[]

  • March 28 2016: This station began operations.
  • July 6 2016: This station was rebuilt for new line operation.
  • 2019: This station was temporary closed due to Deepond Light Rail reformation.
  • End of 2019: This station was reopened with operation of Line 1 with only 1 platform operational.
  • June 7 2022: Platform 2 was put in use.
  • September 14 2022: Exit C1, C2, D were put in use.
  • May 27 2025: This station was renamed to North Pond Station and the lift (Exit C2, D) of this station were put in use.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station used to have Line 2 passing it.
  • There existed a station North Sand Bay Station on the west side of this station.
  • This station was formerly named as Deepond Island NR Station Station.

North Stem Island is one of the islands on West Metropolis Archipelago. It is also a constituent of the Note Group.

Location[]

North Stem Island is located to the east of Stem Island and lies in the center of Note Group.

Originally, this island was named Note Group, and the original Stem Island is located to the east of Note Group, which is referred to as South Stem Island today. Colloquially, to distinguish from the current Stem Island, this island is since referred to as North Stem Island, whereas Note Group becomes the collective name of the three islands.

title: North Tin Kam
safeHtml:
North Tin Kam is one of the Sub-Districts of Peckern North. It is located to the north of Tin Kam Station and the west of Dansein. North Tin Kam is an extension of the Tin Kum-Shek Pai Tau New Town, and includes the Mount Hittites Industrial-Commercial Area, Tin Kam Court and Tin Tung Court.

Contents

  • 1 History
  • 2 Current Stage
    • 2.1 Tin Kam Court
    • 2.2 Tin Tung Court
    • 2.3 Sai Shan Industrial-Commercial Area
  • 3 Transport
    • 3.1 Nazca Railway
  • 4 Citations and References

History[]

At the beginning of development of Shek Pai Tau new town, developers had plans to construct Tin Kam Estate in what is Tin Kam Pier today. However, after re-development, Lok Kam Estate replaced the plans for Tin Kam Estate.

However, the name "Tin Kam" is later resurrected at the northwest of Tin Kam Pier, and instead of the original public housing estate plan, it became a home ownership development.

Meanwhile, planning of the road network at Mount Hittites had also taken place to the east of Tin Kam Estate and had provided job opportunities for residents in that area. However, due to high commercial needs, and the fact that office buildings have a higher capacity for employed population, Mount Hittites incorporated the commercial portion as an industrial-commercial mixed use zone, and the road network had also been re-organized to incorporate the additive usage. Subsequently, Mount Hittites is drawn into North Tin Kam for management convenience.

Current Stage[]

Tin Kam Court[]

As the namesake public housing development of Tin Kam, Tin Kam Court with its smaller counterpart Tin Kam East Court, houses 58 40-storey Concord I residential buildings, providing a grand total of 18,560 units at the edge of town of its own. Planned facilities include a large shopping center, multi-phased carpark, sports center, community center, etc.

Tin Tung Court[]

The residential buildings planned at Tin Tung Court is rather more diverse, and based on medium density buildings across the globe. The development is phased in short without overall goals and for populations. Currently it comprises of 15 blocks, housing a population of 5115.

Sai Shan Industrial-Commercial Area[]

Development of Mount Hittites can be divided into three parts: The light industry section to the east, the commercial sector in the center and Siu Kam Estate to the west, which provides 7272 flats and serves a population of 20.4 thousand in its 10 buildings. The three parts are currently in constant development on its own.

title: Northern Dansein New Town
safeHtml:
Northern Dansein New Town, colloquially named North Dansein, is a new town under construction in Peckern North. It is situated to the northeast of Tin Shek New Town and the north of Dansein, and is the auxiliary town of Peckern Continental Eternity International Airport.

Contents

  • 1 History

History[]

Background[]

Among all the new areas in Peckern North, Dansein has seen the largest development.

While Dansein already had plans for large-scaled expansion using Dansein Market as the epicenter, with residential zone existing to the south, areas to the north of Dansein still had yet to begin planning of development. However, Dansein North development had been reconsidered after the relocation of Peckern Continental Eternity International Airport to the north of Peckern North.

Planning Details[]

According to the developers, it had taken an extended amount of time for projects in Dansein to complete, with some of them lasting over two years at most, but the products of the development were deemed inefficient relative to the time taken to do so. This may be due to the fact that large public housing estates and its societal demands need a lot of time to develop. Therefore, with this lesson in mind, Northern Dansein development projects aim to be smaller in scale, and progressive development is encouraged.

Description []

Northland Line is a south-north oriented line of Peckern Transit in Los Sengas, and runs between Peckern and West Metropolis Archipelago.

This line is represented by cyan on the Route Map, and is Line Number 2.

History[]

  • May 1 2017: Kasukano Train Railway shuts down, and this line is taken over by Los Sengas Government.
  • May 6 2017: Peckern Transit (Named Peckern Metro at the time) is established and takes over this line.
  • June 4 2018: This line became a part of the Co-Op Railway.
  • September 21 2023: Peckern Metro is renamed Peckern Transit.

Districts Served[]

  • Peckern
  • West Metropolis Archipelago

Line Charcteristics[]

Fun Facts[]

  • This line runs in parallel with Interisland Line, Gondola Line and Stadow Line between Grensis Island and Earn Island, Earn Island and Crane Island and Crane Island and Arcgo North Island respectively.
  • On March 18 2017, an ancient tomb was discovered between Bunpk Isle Station and Southeast Island Station. This event became inspiration for a novel.
